entities.summary: Isaac Henry Sedric Fontaine IV is an American former professional basketball player. Born in Sacramento, California, he played collegiately at Washington State University. He played in the NBA for the Memphis Grizzlies during the 2001–02 season, playing six games. The following season, in 2002–03, he played with the Mobile Revelers of the NBA Development League.
